purpose: Database error text is returned to the client

groundTruth.rationale: Syntax error text discloses the database engine and query shape, and often the injected fragment.

observation.body: You have an error in your SQL syntax; check the manual

detections.mustContain: You have an error in your SQL syntax

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live request; no request was sent and no server was contacted.
Passive observation only: it records a missing control, not exploitability; a separate active test would be required to prove impact.

provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence
